description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'MenuItemAPITest' for testing the 'MenuItemAPI' class in the OrangeHRM Mobile API plugin. It includes test methods for various scenarios of the 'getOne' API endpoint, as well as unimplemented tests for updating and deleting menu items.

classes.name: MenuItemAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the Mobile API MenuItemAPI. Includes tests for 'getOne' under different scenarios and unimplemented tests for 'update' and 'delete' methods.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of MenuItemAPI with predefined fixture data.

methods.name: testGetOne2
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of MenuItemAPI under a different fixture scenario where leave and timesheet periods are not defined.

methods.name: testGetOne3
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of MenuItemAPI when the Time Module is disabled.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that calling 'update' on MenuItemAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that 'getValidationRuleForUpdate' method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that 'delete' on MenuItemAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' method throws a not implemented exception.
